reason: It's free and it fixes two things I fight with every week — losing my spot mid-binge and scrolling Discord to find whoever posted the chapter link. I'd take the invite and actually use it.
objection: A private site you run yourself still means my reading history and chat are sitting on some random server I know nothing about, and if you get bored of maintaining it my stuff just vanishes.
would_change_my_mind: Finding out you (or anyone) can browse my chat and reading history whenever you want — that would make me skip the invite.
